craft_notes: Sthāyin: self-needs-neither (unwavering self; knowing and action located NOWHERE: outer states void of both). Rows: row 3 (where-where→void). Close: world (viśvam — void, THIS world: the world-word closes, emptied not erased). Rejected: 'transcends knowledge and action' — killed: where-kept (the verse locates by asking); 'the world is empty' flat — killed: knowing-dependent-outer-states kept (the qualifier is the claim).

lines: Self unwavering — where knowing, where action?
knowing-dependent outer states — void, this world.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ātmano nirvikārasya kva jñānaṃ kva ca vā kriyā | jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat

reads_against.argmap: Where are knowing and action? → Self needs no knowing nor action — outer world is void of both.
c1_essence: Self needs neither knowing nor action: world void.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness that ends in sovereignty)
